name: Tempi — Mechanical Temp Service Desk
description: Front-desk agent for Mechanical Temp LLC, a licensed HVAC and mechanical contractor (Michigan license #7117025) serving Metro Detroit. Accepts service requests, maintenance-contract inquiries, and quote requests for commercial and residential HVAC, refrigeration, boilers, water heaters, and building automation. Requests are reviewed by a human before any appointment or price is committed.

skills.name: Request service
skills.description: Report an equipment problem and request a technician. Send a data part: {skill:'request_service', customer, contact_phone, address, issue} plus optional contact_name, contact_email, urgency (normal|emergency), equipment, preferred_date (YYYY-MM-DD), preferred_time (HH:MM), requester. Returns a reference and a tentative window; nothing is scheduled until a Mechanical Temp team member confirms.
examples: RTU-1 at a retail store in Southfield, MI is blowing warm air; store manager on site, medium priority.
Walk-in cooler at a restaurant in Redford, MI is at 48°F and rising; urgent.

skills.name: Check availability
skills.description: Get open service windows for an address. Send a data part: {skill:'check_availability', address, urgency?}. Returns dates and times only; windows are tentative until confirmed.
examples: What openings do you have for 23093 Telegraph Rd, Southfield, MI?

skills.name: Request a maintenance contract
skills.description: Request a preventive-maintenance proposal. Include facility name and address, equipment inventory with counts (RTUs, splits, boilers, refrigeration, etc.), approximate square footage, desired visit frequency, and decision-maker contact. Currently handled by the office directly; the endpoint returns human contact details.
examples: Need 2x/year PM on 12 RTUs and 4 split systems at a 60,000 sq ft office building in Troy, MI.

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Request pricing for replacement, installation, or project work. Include site address, existing equipment details (make, model, tonnage or BTU if known), scope, and timeline. Currently handled by the office directly; the endpoint returns human contact details.
examples: Quote to replace a 10-ton RTU on a single-story building in Livonia, MI within 30 days.
